boundaries: No production, real money, Stripe API or HTTP route dispatch.
Prisma enums parsed from baseline schema; generated Prisma runtime not loaded.
In-memory queries return snapshots; transaction queue and rollback are explicit models, not real DB isolation/advisory/row locks.
Actual repository SQL decrement is an explicit GREATEST arithmetic model, not PostgreSQL execution.
Authorization for sales is an allow stub; gate-off is actual code; no authority/security sign-off.
Synthetic Stripe webhook signing secret exists only in this process and is never emitted.
Fixed ctx.now dates simulate purchase histories; no passage of real months, browser or CDN token expiry test.
R17 fake provider intentionally does not deduplicate; no claim of a duplicate live Stripe refund.
Known manual policies for partial/refund reversal/dispute are distinguished from new R31/R32.
Actual migrated tables and GREATEST/CAS SQL; no TypeScript/Prisma/HTTP execution in this script.
No real Stripe refund/dispute lifecycle, actual webhook delivery or financial operation.
Sequential delivery histories, not a database concurrency/isolation test.
UserPaymentTotal is a per-user aggregate; this is not a demonstrated duplicate charge/refund or creator payout loss.
